queue.name: Aganskaya-Vertikos Gas Pipeline (KS Aganskaya-KS Aleksandrovskaya/Vertikos; Nizhnevartovsk GPZ-Parabel-Kuzbass capacity expansion)
queue.note: New >400 km parallel line KhMAO->Tomsk by 2029 (VSG western feed); no roster row has Aganskaya endpoints. P2350/P7615 are the existing I/II lines and P7612 is Myldzhino-Vertikos, so this is new pipe unless vetting shows it is a PS-2 (P0734) section

evidence.note: Gazprom to build >400 km Aganskaya-Vertikos by 2029 to relieve Tomsk throughput deficit since 2024.
Aganskaya-Aleksandrovskaya section between KhMAO and Tomsk oblast as part of Gazprom's new pipeline project; ties to Power of Siberia 2 western feed.
Aganskaya-Aleksandrovskaya section: laser scanning done, engineering surveys underway; part of the Eastern Gas Supply System, to supply Altai Republic/Krai, Kemerovo, Novosibirsk, Tomsk.

queue.name: Vankor-Khalmerpayutinskoye Gas Pipeline
queue.note: Rosneft Vankor cluster gas route into the UGSS, Krasnoyarsk->YaNAO, ~108 km (snippet length, unverified); no roster row by name or endpoints (Messoyakha-Norilsk and Zapolyarnoye-Novy Urengoy are different lines)

evidence.note: Rosneft release: 30 bcm of gas from the Vankor cluster delivered into the UGSS; the Vankor-Khalmerpayutinskoye trunk gas pipeline is the export route (108 km per other sources).

queue.name: Cherepanovo-Suzun Inter-settlement Gas Pipeline
queue.note: 112 km Novosibirsk Oblast line under construction since 2024-10, serving 9 settlements; no roster row for Cherepanovo or Suzun

evidence.note: Construction began Oct 2024 on 112 km inter-settlement gas pipeline serving 9 settlements (Otvazhny, Barinovo, Yarki, Krutishka, Karaseevo, Shurygino, Shipunovsky, Shipunovo, Suzun) under the 2021-2025 regional program; ~40 km built, completion planned 2026.

queue.name: Tomsk-Asino Gas Pipeline Branch
queue.note: Branch plus GRS Asino completed 2022, ~78 km (length not verified); no Tomsk-Asino row. The P4210 name hint is a false match (Vytegra-Pudozh). May be the OSM seed 'branch to GRS-2 Tomsk' (~79.9 km)

evidence.note: Gas pipeline branch and GRS Asino completed in Asino district; serves Asino, Pervomaiskoe, Zyryanskoe. Length ~78 km (two GRS) per search summaries of TASS/RIA Tomsk (those pages not verifiable: TASS 403, RIA 2017 404).

queue.name: Parabel-Kuzbass Gas Pipeline Second Line (Novokuznetsk)
queue.note: Proposed second line near Novokuznetsk to cover annual maintenance outages, target moved from 2029 to 2027. P7615 (line II, Vertikos-Novokuznetsk) is already operating, so this looks like a new loop. Length unknown; vetting must also check P4056 (Novokuznetsk-Prokopyevsk)

evidence.note: Governor proposes bringing forward completion of the second Parabel-Kuzbass line in Novokuznetsk from 2029 to 2027; purpose is to avoid outages during annual maintenance of the existing line. Length and endpoints not given.

queue.name: Nazyvaevsk District Inter-settlement Gas Pipeline (Loris-Melikovo-Spassk-Kochkovatka)
queue.note: 49.6 km Omsk Oblast line for 7 settlements (2021). P3982 ends at Nazyvaevsk (Tyukalinsk->Nazyvaevsk, 98 km), and this runs on from the Nazyvaevsk area GDS, so it looks like a separate pipe. Vetting must confirm it is not already inside P3982's 98 km

evidence.note: 49.6 km inter-settlement pipeline in Nazyvaevsk district for 7 settlements; ~5 km built Apr 2021, completion Q4 2021 planned; part of Omsk 2021-2025 program (>250 km of branches, 7 GDS).

matched.name: Eastern Gas Supply System (VSG) western section, Yamal-HMAO-Tomsk-Kuzbass-Krasnoyarsk-Irkutsk
matched.reason: This is an umbrella system, not a new segment. Its Siberian trunk (Volodino-Krasnoyarsk, 28.5 bcm/y) is already P6535, with the same 28.5 bcm/y capacity as VSG. Krasnoyarsk-Irkutsk overlaps P2376 (Proskokovo-Achinsk-Krasnoyarsk-Kansk-Balagansk, cancelled). The only named new section (Aganskaya-Aleksandrovskaya) is queued separately as aganskaya-vertikos. Also related: P0734.
matched.other_names_suggestion: Eastern Gas Supply System (Vostochnaya Sistema Gazosnabzheniya, VSG) western section

evidence.note: VSG is over 5,000 km through Yamal, HMAO, Tomsk, Kuzbass, Krasnoyarsk and Irkutsk; Belogorsk-Khabarovsk section under construction since 2024; design capacity 28.5 bcm/y.
Government order lists VSG among 13 Gazprom pipelines.
Preliminary surveys underway between compressor stations in HMAO and Tomsk Oblast; no construction timelines.
